title: Fear
spec: Get out of the ring round the light.

say: This is your swimmer, seen from above: the
tip of its triangle is the way it heads. On
its right, a light, with a dashed ring round it.
At the foot of the drawer, Objectives: what
the level asks, each with its bar. Here, get
out of the ring round the light in time.
It has no eyes and no thrusters yet: it cannot
move. Click the Editor tab, or the Editor
button at the bottom left, to build them.
The board is your swimmer's body, its front to
the right. Where you put a part is where it
sits. Atop it: what a click does now.
Tools: Write builds and Delete removes, with
Undo and Redo. At its foot, the Wheel: what
can be done on the cell you click.
The bar on the left opens the drawers: Tools,
Parts, Files, Diagnostic, Navigator, or press
their initial. At its foot: Settings, Chapters,
and Run, which sets the swimmer going.
The faint shapes show where each part goes
and which way it points. Click this cell, then
the Eye on the Wheel, or press 1.
It looks forward, but this eye must look back
and to the left: Turn left on the Wheel, or L,
twice. It turns by 60 degrees each time.
Now the second eye: click this cell, then the
Eye on the Wheel, or press 1.
This one looks back and to the right: Turn
right on the Wheel, or R, twice.
Parts lists what the level hands out; the (i)
on a row says what the part does. A part can
also be dragged from it onto the board.
Thrusters push the way they point, forward
already. Drag one from Parts onto this cell...
...and the other one here.
Wire each eye to the thruster on its own side:
click the upper eye, then the upper thruster.
Then the lower eye, then the lower thruster.
The light is on the swimmer's right. Click the
Run tab, or Run at the bottom left, or press
Space, and watch.
The run waits for you. Under the arena: start
again, play or pause, a step, fast forward;
then the timeline: click it to go to any time.
Inside: the swimmer's wiring, live. Beads
flow along the wires, the faster the more
light an eye reads.
Press Play, or Space. The right eye sees the
light and drives the right thruster: the
swimmer turns away and flees.
That is fear: it turns away from the light.
Each win is scored on its time and its parts:
a point in Score. Fewer of either is better;
the line joins the wins no other beats.
Close, then Next level when you are ready.
